id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_010.pack|cs_:
A few days after {var:1} and friends defeated
Mordegon and peace came to the world...

{var:1} and the others gathered at Arboria's
place of memories to mourn Veronica...

"Look, Sister. Everyone came today
  to celebrate that the world
  is at peace.

"Oh... the World Tree spreads its leaves
  so contentedly over there.

"A lot has happened, but...
  we really did save the world, didn't we?

"The world was once cloaked in darkness
  by an evil lord. We lost so many
  precious lives...

"But we're alive. If we live and laugh,
  we can start over as many times as we need!

"And if I kept crying,
  Sister would scold me, wouldn't she...

"Are you stupid!? The world is at peace
  and you're making a gloomy face!

"The villagers are impatient to know
  where the guest of honor is.
  Please, everyone, come to the village!

"Finally, the celebration feast!
  Come on, {var:1}, darling!

"I thought Arborians were all strict,
  but everyone is equally happy
  that peace has come.

"It's a party, so let's enjoy it!
  Enough to make Veronica jealous!
